page.overview:
What is Swarog?

Swarog is a fictional entity created for the German-language Call of Cthulhu supplement Berlin: Im Herzen der großen Stadt.

A hideous being appearing as a dark, gigantic, legless bird-like horror swathed in dark flames, Swarog has a long neck topped by a black lump, half of which endowed with a big glowing eye and the other being covered in innumerable tentacles.

It was revered by Slavic and Viking folks as the Solar god Svarog, though sharing almost nothing with the traditional deity.
